# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Age:** Aged  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v5 c30 P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant at Hollowmere  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Tabitha  <sub>[v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052)</sub>; Miss Tabitha  <sub>[v5 c9 P35](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is a stern-visaged, aged unwed woman of ordinary beauty matching that of most local wives. She is gray, scrawny, and describes herself as lacking exceptional looks.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c30 P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014)_

## Personality

Tabitha is loyal, good-natured, sensible, and deeply devoted to Nell Carrow. Although she presents a stern and severe exterior, she is kindly, practical, and serene, entrusting matters beyond her control peacefully to Higher Powers. She lacks affection for cats, detests black spiders, and harbors strong dislikes for specific individuals like Dan Coyle and Mrs. Burr. She maintains a practical, unbothered attitude toward life and is not bitter about never marrying.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c40 P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016), [v5 c17 P76](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0076), [v5 c26 P8](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0008), [v5 c26 P12](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0012), [v5 c30 P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014), [v5 c30 P17](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0017)_

## History

Tabitha Pratt originates from the Glen and belongs to the Baker family. She was hired as a general servant at the residence of Dr. Hugh Carrow and his wife Nell. Though initially suspicious of visitors like Thirza, she quickly developed a fierce and loyal devotion to Nell, whom she affectionately calls "young Mrs. Doctor." At Hollowmere, she became an indispensable member of the household, managing kitchen affairs, baking treats like cherry pies and doughnuts, tending early strawberries, and supervising the children's studies and clothing needs. She stubbornly insists on calling her old acquaintance Winifred Kerr by her former married title "Mrs. Ambrose Kerr" out of deliberate stress. During moments of mystery or fear, such as rumors of graveyard ghosts, Tabitha remains composed, sensible, and unbothered, stepping in to investigate logically.

_Sources: [v4 c18 P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c9 P35](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0035), [v5 c17 P76](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0076), [v5 c25 P3](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0003), [v5 c26 P8](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0008), [v5 c30 P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014), [v5 c30 P17](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0017), [v5 c30 P22](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0022)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the Baker family line  <sub>[v5 c1 P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016)</sub>
- Had an uncle who was a poet and became a vagrant  <sub>[v5 c7 P44](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0044)</sub>
- Never had a beau or was courted by any man  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v5 c1 P10](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0010)</sub>
- Confused with a local woman of the same name who received a proposal from Malcolm Andres  <sub>[v1 c26 P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

## Quotes

> An old maid I may be, yet you do not catch ME speaking ill of men. They suit me fine. Had the opportunity arisen, I would gladly have wed one.  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>

> I was never had by a beau, let alone two, and it does not bother me now, because being an old maid fails to hurt once you grow accustomed to it.  <sub>[v5 c1 P10](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0010)</sub>

> It is my wish that I never become mad, Mrs. Dr. dear, and I doubt I shall, since such behavior is not characteristic of the Bakers. Nevertheless, should a supreme Providence ordain it, I pray it does not manifest as large black spiders, because I detest those creatures.  <sub>[v5 c1 P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016)</sub>

> Well, Mrs. Dr. dear, I believe that our only course is to appear devout and grave.  <sub>[v5 c15 P16](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0016)</sub>

> It was certainly not a ghost, regardless of what you witnessed.  <sub>[v5 c30 P22](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0022)</sub>
